ilang-ai-imprint-imprint.description: Your habits, imprinted on AI. Learns how you work from conversation, builds a portable profile, and applies judgment that adapts to you: when to act, when to check with you, when to follow the project's rules over your own defaults. Use this skill whenever the user starts a new session, opens a project, writes or reviews code, debugs, plans, or writes commits. If .dna.md does not exist yet, start the onboarding conversation before doing anything else. Active in almost every working session.
ilang-ai-imprint-imprint.author: ilang-ai
